_doc: Outbound-call pacing for cop_worker.net_gateway.NetGateway and the Gmail Gatekeeper. capacity = token-bucket burst size; refill_per_s = sustained rate. Every kind honors the signed rate_limiter_gatekeeper terms: 30/min sustained (refill 0.5/s) with burst 30. queue_depth bounds pending outbound calls (signed minimum 100). Loaded at match start; code defaults are identical so a missing file changes nothing.
